product_metadata.title: 18-Inch Folding Bar Stool – Heavy-Duty Padded Portable Stool with 300-Pound Capacity for Dorm, Recreation Room or Game Room by Lavish Home (Gray) Set of 1
features: COMPACT AND FOLDABLE- This 18-inch tall bar stool folds flat for convenient storage in small spaces when it isn’t being used. It also measures just 12.5” wide, making it perfect for dorms and apartments.

300 POUND CAPACITY- The base of this collapsible stool is constructed from 1mm-thick steel tubing for strength and durability. The heavy-duty frame gives the seat a 300-pound weight limit so both children and adults can comfortably use it.

EASY TO CLEAN- This bar stool has extra thick, PVC covered cushioning to provide a comfortable seat. The PVC cover is also easy to clean with a soft, damp cloth or sponge and soapy water. The seat should be dried completely before its next use.
PORTABLE- This foldable seat is designed to be lightweight and compact enough to easily take anywhere. Once folded, the stool easily fits in almost any vehicle for convenient travel to parties.

PRODUCT DETAILS- Materials: PVC and Steel. Open Dimensions: (L) 12” x (W) 11.75” x (H) 18”. Folded Dimensions: (L) 12.5” x (W) 2” x (H) 28”. Seat Diameter: 12.5”. Color: Gray. 300 Pound Weight Capacity. Intended For Indoor Use Only.
description: Set up extra seating in seconds with the 18-Inch Folding Bar Stool by Lavish Home. This collapsible stool is constructed from steel tubing for strength and durability. The heavy-duty metal frame gives the stool a 300-pound weight capacity, making it perfect for both children and adults to use. This stool has a foot rest and an extra thick, PVC-covered cushioned seat for comfort, and it is easy to clean with a soft, damp cloth and soapy water. The spring action lock keeps the foldable stool securely open during use, and the seat can fold flat for convenient storage or easier travel to parties, family gatherings, or wherever you need an extra portable chair.
